name: steward-pr-consolidation
title: workstation-steward: PR consolidation in Claude Code
desc: A retelling of the real pacphi/ampel#86, looping. In Claude Code, /steward:pr-consolidation works in a fresh clone, finds three Dependabot PRs, takes the two in-major bumps (axios, vite) that are at least three days old, defers the major one with its breaking changes written up, fixes twelve RustSec vulnerabilities with lockfile-only updates, justifies one ignore that has no fix without a major, and opens one PR with every CI job green. Merging stays the owner's decision.

segs: A fresh clone in a scratch folder. CI's audit gate: cargo audit, then cargo deny.
Bot PRs: Dependabot #81 axios, #82 i18next-http-backend, #83 vite.
Take, in-major and at least 3 days old: axios ^1.20.0 (#81), vite ^8.3.4 (#83).
Defer, a major: i18next-http-backend 3.0.6 → 4.0.2 (#82); breaking changes written up.
Pre-existing: cargo audit found 12 vulnerabilities; fixed with lockfile-only updates.
One ignore, justified: RUSTSEC-2024-0449 (unsafe-libyaml has no fix without a major).
: one PR in place of #81 and #83.

scenes.out: Merging is yours: #81 and #83 close after it lands; #82 waits for your call.
